title: Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain (Hugenot St / AZ Berman Dr, approx.): body found burning, 17 Oct
summary: Mitchells Plain police were called to the corner of Hugenot Street and AZ Berman Drive, Tafelsig, where a body was found burning; it was burned beyond recognition, a murder case was registered and a post-mortem will iden...
story: Mitchells Plain police were called to the corner of Hugenot Street and AZ Berman Drive, Tafelsig, where a body was found burning; it was burned beyond recognition, a murder case was registered and a post-mortem will identify the deceased (EWN, quoting police spokesperson FC van Wyk). EWN later reported it as a woman's body found on Saturday 17 October.
incident: Found Sat 17 Oct 2026 (EWN, quoting Ian Cameron); time not given
location_note: Corner of Hugenot Street and AZ Berman Drive, Tafelsig. The pin is near the corner; OpenStreetMap spells it Huguenot.
basis: Two reports from one outlet. Police gave the place; the Saturday date and that the victim was a woman come from the second report, quoting Ian Cameron.

other_voices: Ian Cameron, chair of Parliament's police committee
provenance.note: Two reports from one outlet by the same reporter. Police facts, plus a political reaction.
